# MANOVIK AI

> MANOVIK AI is an autonomous AI agent that codes in any language, builds websites, apps, and APIs, and works for you 24/7.

MANOVIK AI is a futuristic AI employee: a streaming, polyglot coding agent with reasoning, private threads, and rich markdown output. It can be self-hosted on your own infrastructure (see the self-hosting guide).

- [Sign in](/login): Sign in or create a MANOVIK AI account.
